$comment: ResearchTriggerEngine (2026-09-04): deterministic, non-LLM logic that decides WHEN to automatically invoke the isolated LangGraph research service (config/langGraphResearch.json) - never an LLM deciding to wake itself up. Off unless researchTriggerEnabledEnvVar is 'true' AND LANGGRAPH_RESEARCH_ENABLED is also 'true' (this engine is meaningless without the underlying research service). Same off-unless-explicit convention as aiCostGovernor.json/langGraphResearch.json.
_minimumCompletedTradesComment: Not empirically derived for THIS purpose - reuses continuousIntelligence.json's championChallengerMinSampleSize (20), the existing 'is this enough evidence to act on' threshold this codebase already uses for a comparable purpose (promoting a challenger strategy). Needs its own calibration once real automatic-trigger history exists.
_minimumResearchIntervalMsComment: Per-strategy cooldown after an automatic run completes, before another can fire for the same strategy - prevents a fast-filling strategy from research-storming. 4 hours is a starting point, not a measured value - requires calibration.
